headline: Saudi-led coalition says it intercepted and destroyed a drone in the Mecca region on Friday Nov 6
dek: [PRIMARY-SOURCE CLAIM -- al-Maliki, X post, Fri Nov 6] Saudi air defences intercepted and destroyed a drone in the Mecca region. No precise location, detection time, intended destination, casualties or damage given.
sources: Saudi-led coalition spokesman Maj. Gen. Turki al-Maliki (X post), via AFP / Al Arabiya / Gulf News
fault_line: Did a Ansar Allah drone really threaten Islam's holiest city -- or is the coalition stretching an interception in the wider Mecca region into a holy-city attack?

sections.what_happened: [PRIMARY-SOURCE CLAIM -- al-Maliki, X post, Fri Nov 6] Saudi air defences intercepted and destroyed a drone in the Mecca region. No precise location, detection time, intended destination, casualties or damage given. [CONTEXT] Second Mecca-region drone interception in three days: a separate drone was intercepted in the Mecca region on Tue Nov 3 (Daily Sabah / Deccan Chronicle / LifeNews, Nov 3) -- do NOT merge the two incidents. The Nov 5 pattern continues: Nov 5 the coalition intercepted a ballistic missile toward Medina + a drone in the Eastern Province (recorded 0500-01); Fri morning Nov 6 it intercepted two ballistic missiles toward Najran (recorded 1400-01). The coalition has NOT attributed the Nov 6 drone to the Ansar Allah and has NOT said it was heading for Mecca city.
sections.what_verified: 3 distinct publisher families with declared tiers carry the coalition claim: AFP (T1 wire, via Kurdistan24/LBC) + Al Arabiya (T3, STATE SA) + Gulf News (T3). Khaleej Times live updates and LBC also carry it but Khaleej Times has NO declared tier in the registry -- attribution only, NOT counted. Kurdistan24 is an AFP relay = 1 family with AFP.
sections.what_disputed: No launcher identified by the coalition; no independent verification of launch, trajectory or interception; no debris/video published. NO fresh Ansar Allah statement on the Nov 6 incident verified: the denial circulating via the AJ edgeone mirror ('Ansar Allah deny targeting Mecca', stamped 09:30Z Nov 6) carries an Oct 30 URL path -- the known re-date trap -- and cannot be dated to Nov 6; the documented Saree denial ('big lie', 'our operations target oil facilities and military bases') belongs to the Nov 3 incident. A second AJ edgeone mirror ('Saudi air defences intercept Ansar Allah barrage near Mecca', stamped 09:43Z Nov 6) carries an Oct 25 URL path -- also a re-date trap, not a new barrage.
sections.why_matters: A drone over Mecca -- intercepted, says the coalition. Second holy-city scare in three days. But Riyadh named no launcher and showed no debris.
sections.context: Background: IN-WINDOW (Gulf News liveblog entry 14:23 ; Al Arabiya published 14:09 GST; Kurdistan24 13:45+03:00) -- Saudi-led coalition says it intercepted and destroyed a drone in the Mecca region on Friday Nov 6; launcher NOT identified

totw_analysis: Our read: A drone over Mecca -- intercepted, says the coalition. Second holy-city scare in three days. But Riyadh named no launcher and showed no debris. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Did a Ansar Allah drone really threaten Islam's holiest city -- or is the coalition stretching an interception in the wider Mecca region into a holy-city attack?
